content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing/animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_abs_1bc_constant simple case. It loads eta_00000 from a relative output directory to get the grid size [n,m] (L4-L5), builds x with dx=2.0 (L6, L8), computes annotation positions: sponge thickness tdw=30*dx (L11), wavemaker band of half-width wd=10.0 centered at wc=150 (L12-L14), west sponge [0 tdw] (L15) and east sponge [x(end)-tdw x(end)] (L16). Snapshot range ns=100, ne=ns — a single frame; a commented alternative range 1..199 exists (L18-L19, L21-L22). It opens a VideoWriter for movie.avi at 10 fps (L31-L33), then loops num=ns:ne (L35): loads eta_<fnum> (L38-L39), plots row 1 of eta versus x (L42), overlays vertical red lines at the wavemaker edges and dashed red lines at both sponge boundaries spanning y=-10..10 (L44-L49), adds grid/labels, pauses 0.1 s (L52-L55), captures the frame and writes it to the video (L57-L58); finally closes the video object (L62).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation array, initially from eta_00000, reloaded per frame (L4, L39)
n, m — grid dimensions from size(eta) (L5)

equations.ref: east sponge extent at domain end

io.name: per-frame plot of eta(1,:) vs x with wavemaker and sponge boundary lines

verbatim_spans.text: vidObj = VideoWriter('movie.avi');  % Set filename to write video file

unresolved: ns=100, ne=ns (L21-L22) makes the loop run exactly one frame, so movie.avi contains a single frame despite the 10 fps VideoWriter setup; the commented range ns=1/ne=199 (L18-L19) suggests the full animation was disabled.
Annotation values wc=150, wd=10.0, tdw=30*dx (L11-L13) are asserted graphically; agreement with the tide_abs_1bc_constant input.txt wavemaker/sponge settings is not verifiable from this script.
The axis command matching the 1D domain is commented out (L51), so axis limits are auto-scaled per frame, which can make the video jitter between frames if the full range were enabled.
